DIV8.HEAD: § 9.10-5 Minimum bow height.
DIV8.P: (a) The bow height of a harbour craft must be not less than 1.25 metres measured at the forward perpendicular.
(b) A craft shorter than 12 metres may have a bow height of 0.90 metres if it is fitted with a weathertight forecastle.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9.10-10 Air pipes.
DIV8.P: (a) Air pipes on the weather deck must extend at least 760 millimetres above the deck.
(b) Each air pipe must have a permanently attached means of closing.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9.10-15 Freeing ports.

DIV8.HEAD: § 9.20-1 Oily water discharge.
DIV8.P: (a) A harbour craft must not discharge oily water containing more than 15 parts per million of oil.
(b) Discharges are not permitted within 3 nautical miles of the nearest land.
